title: Apply v = u + at

hook.scenario: Aapki flight runway par rest se start hoti hai aur lagatar accelerator full rakhti hai. Aapko ye pata karna hai ki 15 seconds baad take-off ke time uski speed kya hogi.
hook.question: Time, acceleration, aur starting speed ko use kar ke exactly future ki speed kaise predict karte hain?

mental_model.intuition: Final Speed = Shuruati Speed + (Speed badhne ka rate × Kitni der tak badhi).
mental_model.description: Ye equation bas common sense ka math translation hai. 'at' wala part ye batata hai ki total speed me kitna 'izaafa' (increase/decrease) hua. Us izaafa ko purani speed 'u' me jod do, aur aapko nayi speed 'v' mil jayegi.

explanation:
Newton ki first equation of motion hai: v = u + at. Darasal, ye equation directly acceleration ke definition wale formula (a = (v-u)/t) se hi aati hai. Jab aap time 't' ko left mein bhej kar 'a' ke sath multiply karte hain, aur phir 'u' ko shift karte hain, to ye nayi shakal le leti hai.

Is equation ka sabse bada faida tab hota hai jab problem mein 'displacement (s)' ka koi zikr na ho. Agar aapko ek gaadi ki initial speed pata hai (u), acceleration pata hai (a), aur ye pata hai ki wo kitni der tak accelerate ki (t), toh aap easily bata sakte hain ki us specific time ke end mein gadi kis speed par hogi (v).

Signs ka dhyaan rakhna yahan bohot zaruri hai. Agar object breaks maar raha hai ya oppose ho raha hai, toh acceleration 'a' negative hogi. Aise mein (at) wala term negative ho jayega, aur final speed 'v' aapki initial speed 'u' se kam aayegi. Ye equation object ke stop hone ka exact time nikalne ke liye bhi perfect hai, kyunki jab object stop hota hai toh uski final velocity v = 0 hoti hai.

Ek tip: Humesha dhyaan rakhein ki u aur v dono same units (prefer m/s) mein hon, aur time bhi unhi ke matching units (prefer s) mein ho. Agar nahi hain, toh solve karne se pehle conversion rule zaroor lagayein.

key_points.title: First Equation of Motion
key_points.detail: v = u + at. It establishes a relationship between velocity, acceleration, and time without needing distance.

key_points.title: Deceleration cases
key_points.detail: If brakes are applied, use a negative value for 'a', which will naturally make the final velocity 'v' smaller.

key_points.title: Finding stopping time
key_points.detail: If an object stops, set v = 0 and solve for t = -u / a.

worked_example.problem: A car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at a rate of 4 m/s^2. What will be its velocity after 5 seconds?

steps.narration: Starts from rest means u = 0, a = 4, t = 5. Pucha hai final velocity (v).

worked_example.problem: A cyclist moving at 10 m/s applies brakes and produces a retardation of 2 m/s^2. Find his final velocity after 3 seconds.

steps.narration: Initial velocity u = 10. Retardation means a = -2. Time t = 3.
Substitute these values into v = u + at.

common_mistakes.title: Forgetting the negative sign for brakes
common_mistakes.explanation: Bache retardation dekhte hain par equation me v = u + at me 'a' ki jagah seedha +2 daal dete hain, jisse answer badh kar 16 aa jata hai. Brakes hamesha speed ghatate hain.

common_mistakes.title: Not converting units first
common_mistakes.explanation: Agar speed 36 km/h me hai aur time 2 s me, to bina 5/18 use kiye directly 36 + (a*2) karne par numerical pura fail ho jayega.

recall_questions.q: State the first equation of motion.
Which variable is completely missing from the first equation of motion?
What is a key takeaway about apply v u at?
recall_questions.answer: Refer to the fundamental concepts of motion.

oa_questions.question: A train starting from rest attains a velocity of 72 km/h in 5 minutes. Assuming that the acceleration is uniform, find the acceleration.
A particle moves with an initial velocity of 5 m/s and a constant acceleration of 2 m/s^2. Find its velocity after 10 s.
oa_questions.approach: Direct application of v = u + at. v = 5 + (2 * 10) = 5 + 20 = 25 m/s.
